cases.explain: «алая лента» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Your lips are like scarlet thread. Your mouth is lovely. Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.

cases.explain: «гранатовыми деревьями» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates, with precious fruits, henna with spikenard plants,

cases.explain: «северный ветер» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Awake, north wind, and come, you south! Blow on my garden, that its spices may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and taste his precious fruits.
